verdict.rationale: OCI documents its own IAM policies that govern control of resources in tenancies, so the core capability exists. However, the pack does not show the fine-grained mechanics the story asks for. missing for 10: policy conditions, resource-level/compartment scoping details, documented policy evaluation logic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, least privilege is expressible — fine-grained IAM policies with conditions, resource-level scoping, and documented policy evaluation

citations.quote: IAM policies govern control of resources in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) tenancies.
